item.title: k8s: Why Is My Kubernetes Job Still Pending? Tracing Kueue Admission with Headlamp
item.description:
The article introduces the Headlamp Kueue plugin, which helps trace why a Kubernetes Job is still suspended by checking Kueue admission state before looking at Pod scheduling. It walks through a Headlamp-based workflow for inspecting Workloads, LocalQueues, ClusterQueues, ResourceFlavors, and Cohorts, and notes that the 0.1.0-alpha release is read-only.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog

item.title: k8s: Spotlight on SIG Apps
item.description:
SIG Apps is working on workload controller reliability, node lifecycle handling, and new patterns for AI and distributed workloads while preserving backward compatibility. The article highlights current focus areas, the trade-offs in changing core APIs, and a proposed Job API update for Kubernetes 1.38.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog
